entries.text: groupconcat 改为解析为 analytic function

entries.text: 优化结果集唯一性判断，以支持 RuleUnnecessaryDistinctEliminationRewrite
entries.textEn: Improved result-set uniqueness detection for RuleUnnecessaryDistinctEliminationRewrite

entries.text: 优化 RuleQueryFoldingRewrite、RuleSelectSSQRewrite、RuleFilterPredicatePushDownRewrite 的处理逻辑
entries.textEn: Reworked the handling in RuleQueryFoldingRewrite, RuleSelectSSQRewrite and RuleFilterPredicatePushDownRewrite

entries.text: RuleOrderFromDiffTablesRewrite 与 TCRewriter 的 SATTC 重写支持 ValueExpressionTableExpr
entries.textEn: SATTC rewriting in RuleOrderFromDiffTablesRewrite and TCRewriter supports ValueExpressionTableExpr

entries.text: 配置为非重写时重写规则可直接返回
entries.textEn: Rewrite rules return early when configured as non-rewriting

entries.text: 排除无表的派生表
entries.textEn: Derived tables without a table are excluded

entries.text: 修复 date_format 重写优化算法
entries.textEn: Fixed the date_format rewrite algorithm

entries.text: 优化 RuleOrCond4SelectRewrite：分支互斥时不加主键、无 group by 时保留 limit/order by、解决选择列重名
entries.textEn: Improved RuleOrCond4SelectRewrite: no primary key for mutually exclusive branches, keep limit/order by without group by, resolve duplicate select-column names

entries.text: 优化 OR 条件 SELECT 重写的代价模型
entries.textEn: Improved the cost model for OR-condition SELECT rewrites

entries.text: 修复 dataTypeFunctionCall 语法解析异常
entries.textEn: Fixed a dataTypeFunctionCall syntax exception

entries.text: 为语法异常提供行信息
entries.textEn: Syntax exceptions now carry line information

entries.text: SQL 指纹替换所有常量
entries.textEn: SQL fingerprints replace every constant

entries.text: 修复 delete using 的序列化逻辑，支持无括号函数（current_date）
entries.textEn: Fixed delete using serialisation and support parenthesis-free functions such as current_date

entries.text: 使用关键字集合优化性能
entries.textEn: Performance improved with a keyword set

entries.text: 执行计划树不再做 transferSQL，由调用方处理
entries.textEn: The execution-plan tree no longer calls transferSQL; the caller does

entries.text: 修复只有 SQL 语句时脚本解析返回为空的问题；优化 grammar 提升性能
entries.textEn: Fixed script parsing returning empty for SQL-only input; grammar optimisation for speed

entries.text: 修复引用被重复输出的问题；重命名解析器热启动参数
entries.textEn: Fixed duplicate output of references and renamed the parser warm-up parameter

entries.text: 通过系统变量控制是否预热 ANTLR DFA
entries.textEn: ANTLR DFA warm-up is controlled by a system property

entries.text: 提升脚本解析器性能
entries.textEn: Improved script parser performance

entries.text: 优化 PostgreSQL 与通用解析器，提升性能
entries.textEn: Improved the PostgreSQL and universal parsers

entries.text: grammar 优化
entries.textEn: Grammar optimisations

entries.text: 预热 ATN 缓存
entries.textEn: Warm up the ATN cache

entries.text: 找不到列的报错只记日志，不再计入异常
entries.textEn: Column not-found errors are logged instead of counted as exceptions

entries.text: 脚本解析器支持无分号 SQL
entries.textEn: The script parser supports SQL without semicolons

entries.text: 支持 MySQL PL grammar

entries.text: 脚本解析器支持 += 赋值
entries.textEn: The script parser supports += assignment

entries.text: 把 SQL Server 从 script 解析移到 tsql 解析

entries.text: 优化 PostgreSQL 脚本解析器，提升健壮性
entries.textEn: More robust PostgreSQL script parser

entries.text: 优化通用解析器，支持更复杂的谓词表达式（如 @>）
entries.textEn: The universal parser handles more complex predicates such as @>

entries.text: TDSQL 不再消除索引列方向；新增最大排序列数阈值

entries.text: 提供索引清理失败信息
entries.textEn: Index clean-up failures are reported

entries.text: 修复语法规则过滤的缺陷
entries.textEn: Fixed syntax-rule filtering
